baseline_models.focus_anchor: The purposive construction لِتَسْلُكُوا, the plural سُبُلًا, and the qualifier فِجَاجًا jointly anchor traversable plurality in the focus ayah.
baseline_models.mechanism: Traversal, an extended means of reaching, and a wide opened pass reinforce one another, turning the earth from undifferentiated surface into a usable route network.

activation_trace.role: Going through a path supplies the locomotion that makes the clause an operative traversal model.
An extended traversed way, including a means by which something is reached, supplies both route and directed access.
The wide opened mountain pass gives the plural ways breadth, clearance, and terrain-scale continuity.

changed_reading.before: The clause merely permits walking on the earth.
changed_reading.after: The clause presents the earth as configured with multiple broad corridors by which destinations can actually be reached.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence تَسْلُكُوا مِنْهَا and the open-spacing image available to فِجَاجًا support passage through or out from a containing medium.
baseline_models.mechanism: The insertion branch of س ل ك shifts motion from travel over a surface to entry and passage within it; the plural ways become channels, while فجاج supplies the intervals that keep them open.

activation_trace.role: Letting something enter into something supplies passage within a medium rather than motion only across its exterior.
The extended way supplies the internal channel along which the entering movement can continue.
Opened spacing between two things makes the channels permeable and distinguishes them from a sealed mass.

changed_reading.before: People move along roads laid on top of the earth.
changed_reading.after: People pass through a permeable earth by means of multiple opened channels, with مِنْهَا retaining a live from-within or out-from relation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus noun سُبُلًا carries branches of downward release and falling rain, while س ل ك and ف ج ج can supply insertion and apertures.
baseline_models.mechanism: If the non-road branches of س ب ل remain active, the ways can be conduits for material descent: something is sent downward, admitted into openings, and distributed through a plural channel system.

activation_trace.role: Insertion into another thing provides the transfer operation for a conduit reading.
Letting something down from above contributes the vertical direction of flow through the ways.
Falling rain supplies the material that the plural conduits could carry.
Opened spacing supplies apertures through which the descending material can be distributed.

changed_reading.before: The ways are exclusively pedestrian roads.
changed_reading.after: The plural ways may also image a material distribution network, especially channels that admit and carry descending flow.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier sequence sends down abundant flow, extends provision, and makes rivers that cut and open the ground. Those context branches activate the focus ayah's latent descent, insertion, and aperture branches, so سبلًا فجاجًا can carry both travelers and the water system that makes terrestrial routes and growth possible.

activation_trace.role: Insertion into a place or state supplies the transfer of descending water into terrestrial channels.
Downward release makes the focus ways vertically connected rather than merely horizontal roads.
The falling-rain branch gives the released material a specific hydrological image.
Opened intervals provide the ground apertures and widened channels through which water can move.
Sending and setting in motion supplies the initiating downward dispatch of the sky's flow.
A river cutting the earth with flowing water supplies the visible terrestrial channel produced by the descent.
Opening and widening until something flows directly links water movement to the focus image of broad apertures.
Abundant outflow from a source supplies continuity and volume to the descending material.
Flowing water replenished by further water supplies a connected, sustained distribution system.

structural_cues: 71:11-12 moves from sent abundant rain to gardens and explicitly made rivers.
71:19-20 moves from the earth made as a spread surface directly into the purpose clause for traversing its broad ways.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies descent, abundant outflow, replenished water, rivers, insertion, and openings; I infer that these elements form one channel network that also conditions human travel. A live alternative keeps the water sequence and pedestrian roads adjacent but functionally separate.

changed_reading.before: Broad ways are dry roads available for human locomotion.
changed_reading.after: Broad ways participate in a coupled earth-water infrastructure: descent enters opened channels, cuts rivers, supports growth, and also yields traversable corridors.

context_deltas.mechanism: A people are called, flee the call, disobey, follow others, and become lost from a directed course. The focus plural of road-users and ways therefore becomes a social field of competing trajectories: broad access enables movement but does not determine which course a collective takes.

activation_trace.role: Taking a path supplies enacted direction, so response is rendered as movement rather than static assent.
People of the road turns the second-person plural into a collective of route-users whose courses can diverge.
The wide pass supplies ample mobility while remaining neutral about destination.
The human group supplies the collective subject whose route choices the focus plural can organize.
Calling and inclining by speech supplies an offered direction toward which the people may move.
Flight supplies movement away from the offered direction and demonstrates that mobility can enact refusal.
Departure from obedience supplies the evaluative break between an available course and the course actually taken.
Following behind supplies social route selection, with one actor's course becoming another's track.
Loss of guidance and intended direction supplies the failed-route outcome of collective following.

structural_cues: The call in 71:5 is immediately answered by increased flight in 71:6.
After the focus ayah, 71:21-24 chains disobedience, following, and increased straying.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a group, calling, flight, following, and loss of direction; I map those response verbs onto the focus ayah's physical route system. The live alternative is that 71:20 concerns only terrestrial mobility and the social sequence supplies no route metaphor.

changed_reading.before: Multiple broad roads are an uncomplicated benefit.
changed_reading.after: The broad roads are morally non-determinative affordances: a people can answer a call, flee, follow a rival track, or lose direction across the same open field.

context_deltas.mechanism: Successive stages, human growth from earth, return into it, and emphatic emergence from it turn مِنْهَا in the focus clause into a hinge. Traversal can describe not only travel during life but the staged itinerary by which humans arise from, re-enter, and come out of the terrestrial medium.

activation_trace.role: Entry or caused passage within something supplies movement through the earth as a containing stage.
An extended means of reaching supplies continuity across otherwise separate phases of the itinerary.
Opened spacing supplies the passages by which entry, return, and emergence remain possible.
Successive states supply the temporal segmentation of the route through existence.
Human arising and development supplies an explicitly anthropological form of earthly growth.
Soft growth-bearing earth supplies the generative medium from which the human itinerary begins.
Return after departure supplies the itinerary's reversal back into its originating medium.
Passing to the outside supplies the terminal emergence that reopens the route from within the earth.

structural_cues: 71:14 introduces successive stages; 71:17-18 then says humans grow from the earth, return in it, and are brought out emphatically.
The nearby pronoun sequence من الأرض, فيها, and منها repeatedly makes earth the origin, container, and point of departure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies stages, growth from earth, return, emergence, and the focus phrase منها; I infer that the broad ways integrate those events as an itinerary. A live alternative limits سبلًا فجاجًا to roads used only between birth and death.

changed_reading.before: The verse concerns routes used while people live on the earth.
changed_reading.after: The verse can also gather a larger earthly itinerary: staged growth from the earth, passage within it, return into it, and opened emergence from it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding ayah describes the earth as deliberately made into a spread carpet, and the ب س ط inventory itself includes travel through lands. The purpose clause in 71:20 therefore specifies the function of that making: spreadness becomes usable mobility through broad routes.

activation_trace.role: Traversing a path supplies the human operation enabled by the spread surface.
Extended ways and means of reaching supply the functional infrastructure produced on the earth.
Wide passes specify that the mobility affordance operates at landscape scale.
Making something into a condition supplies deliberate configuration rather than accidental terrain.
The massive carpet image supplies the material surface whose spreadness is made useful.
Spreading and extension against contraction supplies room for continuous movement.
Travel through lands makes mobility an explicit branch-level function of the preceding spreadness.

structural_cues: 71:19 and 71:20 form a making-plus-purpose sequence: the earth is made a carpet so that the addressees may traverse.
The second-person plural and plural ways frame the affordance as shared infrastructure rather than a private track.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deliberate making, carpet-like spreadness, a travel branch, and the following purpose clause; I infer a design relation from surface configuration to public mobility. The live alternative treats the juxtaposition as general beneficence without a precise functional arrow.

changed_reading.before: The earth happens to contain roads.
changed_reading.after: The earth's spread form is a deliberately usable mobility affordance whose purpose is realized in shared, broad route access.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context differentiates protective covering, self-covering, layered closure, and truth-covering. Against that repeated enclosure, the focus branches of eye-film, insertion, and opened spacing make the broad ways a permeability image: an opening can conduct movement, while a covering can protect or obstruct it.

activation_trace.role: Entry into something supplies permeability as the condition required for passage.
The web-like eye film supplies an obstructed-perception counterimage to an open way.
Opening the interval between things supplies the removal of closure needed for passage and sight.
Covering that preserves and protects supplies the beneficial pole of enclosure.
A cover laid over something supplies the people's enacted obstruction of reception.
Closure or adhesion that prevents expansion supplies the spatial opposite of broad opened ways.
Covering and concealment supplies the obstructive pole when closure hides what should remain accessible.

structural_cues: 71:7 physically stages blocked hearing through fingers and garments, while 71:20 stages broad passability.
Protective covering in the forgiveness sequence and obstructive covering later keep the polarity from reducing to a simple cover-bad/open-good equation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies several materially different coverings plus a focus aperture; I infer that permeability organizes their contrast and extends it to reception. A live alternative treats these as unrelated branch images with no shared perceptual mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The broad ways are only open terrain.
changed_reading.after: The broad ways also image selective permeability: created openings permit movement and reception within a context where coverings can either preserve or obstruct.

context_deltas.mechanism: The active second-person traversal of broad ways is later answered by a passive sequence of engulfment and caused entry into fire. The س ل ك insertion branch explicitly accommodates entry into a place, state, or punishment, making the two movements a sharp agency contrast rather than two unrelated motions.

activation_trace.role: Causing someone to enter a place, state, or punishment supplies the bridge from offered traversal to compelled passage.
Multiple means of reaching supply the available field in which the addressees initially retain route agency.
Opened spacing supplies the freedom and room that distinguish the focus movement from later confinement.
Kindled fire supplies the terminal medium into which the later passage is compelled.
Drowning in water supplies engulfment that removes ordinary control over movement.
Entry into an interior supplies the forced transition from engulfing water to fire.

structural_cues: 71:20 uses an active second-person purpose clause, whereas 71:25 chains two passive verbs: أُغْرِقُوا فَأُدْخِلُوا.
The broad plural ways of 71:20 contrast with the singularly constrained water-to-fire sequence and the absence of helpers in 71:25.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies active spacious traversal, passive engulfment, passive entry, and the insertion-into-punishment branch; I infer a reversal from afforded agency to compelled transit. A live alternative reads the later punishment sequence without retrospective effect on 71:20.

changed_reading.before: The verse simply lists another earthly convenience.
changed_reading.after: The verse marks an offered interval of spacious route agency, sharpened by the later reversal in which movement becomes passive, engulfed, and compelled.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because thread and garment-edge branches are remote from ordinary road language, but it remains anchored in both تَسْلُكُوا and the opened-spacing qualifier and is activated by the packet's clothing and carpet images. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for a spread earth articulated by seams or slits, not as a lexical translation of the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus س ل ك inventory contains both sewing thread and an extended garment-edge strip or slit, while ف ج ج supplies opened spacing.

activation_trace.role: Used sewing thread supplies the linear material that joins and traces a fabric-like surface.
An extended strip or slit along a garment edge supplies a seam-like analogue for a long terrestrial route.
Opened spacing turns the seam image into a usable slit or interval rather than a decorative line.
Clothing and covering supplies an explicit fabric domain elsewhere in the packet.
The spread earth or carpet supplies the large textile-like field on which seams can organize passage.

changed_reading.before: Roads lie independently on an earth-carpet.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, the broad routes are seams or opened slits that articulate the spread earth itself into a connected fabric.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the grain-ear and unripe branches are not the ordinary senses of سبلًا فجاجًا, yet both are focus-root branches and the context explicitly supplies successive stages and human growth from earth. Downstream prose should label it a branch-activated maturation overlay, never a replacement translation or a claim that فجاجًا literally means immature here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus inventories pair an ear-of-grain branch for س ب ل with a raw or unripe branch for ف ج ج, while س ل ك retains passage along a course.

activation_trace.role: Going through a course supplies movement across developmental phases.
The extended ear of grain supplies a concrete growth form for the plural pathways.
The raw or unripe state supplies incompletion and makes traversal a process toward maturity.
Successive states supply the ordered developmental stages through which the course passes.
Human arising and rearing supplies the bridge from botanical growth imagery to human maturation.

changed_reading.before: The verse describes only completed roads across mature terrain.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory overlay, the broad ways become developmental courses through which earth-grown humans move from incompletion across successive stages.

strongest_changes: The rain-river sequence activates a hydrological reading in which broad ways are channels that admit, distribute, and are shaped by descending flow.
The stages-growth-return-emergence sequence expands terrestrial traversal into a life-cycle itinerary through, into, and out from earth.
The immediate carpet-purpose sequence makes route access a designed public affordance, while the later passive water-to-fire entry sharpens it as a temporary field of agency.
The call-flight-following-straying sequence makes plural routes socially and morally non-determinative rather than automatically guiding.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots contain unusually productive cross-material branches: insertion, downward release, rain, eye-film, thread, grain, rawness, and opened spacing. Context did not collapse these into one interpretation; it activated coexisting hydraulic, spatial, developmental, social, perceptual, and agency-based mechanisms.
remaining_uncertainties: The downward-release and rain branches of س ب ل may be productive analogy only, rather than live semantic pressure on the focus plural noun.
The exact force of مِنْهَا remains decisive: movement from, within, or by means of the earth weights the surface-route and emergence models differently.
The social route and covering-opening models depend on reader-supplied mapping from physical passage to response and perception, even though every component is packet-backed.
The fabric and maturation outliers are deliberately retained branch-distance effects and should not be promoted to unqualified readings.
